ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to approximately 10-15% of the visible area, primarily concentrated in small-scale stippling and localized edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white stippling is concentrated at the basal junction of the lobes. Distinctive light-gray circular ring structures are localized in the upper-medial region of the right lobe and the mid-lateral region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center of the trailing edge, with a calculated internal angle of approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large-amplitude irregularities and jagged peaks present on the distal portions of both lobes, contrasted against a smoother profile near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrically convex curvature on the outer margins of both lobes, transitioning into sharply tapered, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular rings (rosette scars) detected: one isolated ring on the mid-left lobe and a cluster of approximately four rings on the upper-medial surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical-to-diagonal parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the inner lower section of the left lobe, cutting through the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, high-contrast clusters of biological growth (barnacles) are attached to the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, resulting in irregular pixel boundaries at the extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white 'salt-and-pepper' stippling pattern concentrated where the fluke lobes merge with the peduncle area.
